title: Steamed Dumplings with Polish Wrap
description: Steamed dumplings wrapped in polish wrap with a delicious dipping sauce. A tasty and healthy Chinese dish.

ingredients.name: Quick mix of vegetables
ingredients.notes: such as cabbage, carrots, and scallions

instructions: 1. In a large mixing bowl, combine quick mix of vegetables.
2. Lay a polish wrap flat and place a spoonful of vegetable mix in the center of the wrap.
3. Fold the bottom half of the wrap over the filling, then fold in the sides and roll up the wrap to form a tight cylinder.
4. Repeat with the remaining wraps and filling.
5. In a steamer basket, place the dumplings seam-side down.
6. Steam the dumplings over boiling water for 10-12 minutes, or until cooked through.
7. In a small bowl, mix together vegetable oil and a pinch of salt.
8. Serve the steamed dumplings with the dipping sauce and enjoy!
